What’s in—and what’s next door.

The 70-resort core list

The official directory shows 70 properties with its Marriott Vacation Club® brand filter applied. “City Collection” is a label within that list, not a separate brand. The former Pulse urban properties are represented there.

The wider 100-resort directory

The unfiltered site shows 100 resorts across multiple brands. It also offers these separate filters:

  • Grand Residences by Marriott®
  • Sheraton® Vacation Club
  • The Ritz-Carlton Club®
  • Westin® Vacation Club
  • Unbranded

A notable gap

Mexico has no property under the Marriott Vacation Club® brand filter, even though Mexico listings may appear under other filters in the wider directory.

Open question

The official site confirmed 100 resorts across all brands and 70 in the core MVC list. Per-brand counts for the other five filters could not be verified.
